## Requirements (contract § In scope — deliverables)

1. Home (QW-9; K12b NEW-14): key figures first; the full metric set lives on
   `/coverage-metrics/`; one label per quantity + a "what this counts" line.
2. Capability promises (K14 NEW-11): promises the release does not show render
   as being built or N-2 "Not operating yet."
3. Dossier "How we know this" (QW-6; R1.7): labelled "Site-wide" with corrected
   labels; site-wide totals no longer read as dossier figures (F-05, F-109,
   F-132).
4. Unknowns (QW-7): the incompleteness banner counts every unknown; empty
   sections say "No record in SIG" without asserting an absence kind the data
   lacks (F-100, F-136; F-422's W0 half — see Boundaries).
5. Contradictions (K12b NEW-17): the "contradictions kept visible" claim is
   honestly scoped — the records stay in the record but are not yet browsable
   on the site; that view is being built.
6. QW-5 (R1.6; this row owns it, TS-12): "reproducible" dropped; "permalink" →
   "link" until `/s/` pins exist.
7. QW-14: CC0 stated (the contributed-to-OSM subset is CC0-1.0, LICENSE §42),
   the corrections-log start date and why its counts can be structurally zero
   shown; the `/contribution-back/` nav link removed (C-12 withdrew the route,
   LATER-03; SIG-OPS-003 keeps it off the allow-list — not restored).
8. Copy: every new/changed public sentence is agent-drafted into copy batch #1
   (`docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md`: page, text, sha256, status);
   a build check fails when a changed page carries a sentence that is neither
   confirmed nor an N-string (B-2).

Out of scope: publication (P34.17's L2 republish); real `/s/` pinning
(D-J3-6/P36.66b); re-export of spine data (P34.21b); the capstone journeys.

## Plan

1. `web/src/lib/dossier.ts`: `dossierUnknowns(dossier)` counts every field the
   page cannot answer — gaps of every non-EVIDENCE_OF_ABSENCE kind,
   `absence` rows, bare `null` rows, and every null action-block field —
   deduplicated by `(subject_id, predicate_id)` with the more-informative kind
   winning (searched/contested outranks not-researched), plus
   `emptySectionCount`; `NO_RECORD_IN_SIG` for empty sections;
   `SECTION_ACTION_BLOCKS` shared by page + print; `renderDossierJson` gains
   `unknown_field_count`/`empty_section_count` additively.
2. `IncompletenessBanner` + `[slug].astro` + `print.astro` + `WhatWeDontKnow`:
   banner names the full unknown count and the empty-section count; empty
   sections render "No record in SIG." with no kind asserted.
3. `HowWeKnowThis` + `provenance.ts` + `BaseLayout`: scope line ("Site-wide —
   these figures describe the whole record, not this page." for the default
   site summary; "This page's figures." for a page-supplied summary); corrected
   labels ("Evidence artifacts", "Claims by evidence tier", "Ruleset applied",
   "Human review status"); optional `denominator` line when the export summary
   carries one; the `/contribution-back/` and `/visual-language/` nav links
   removed.
4. QW-5: `Citation.astro` says "Link to this page" + honestly describes the
   as-of selector it carries; `index.astro`, `dossier/index.astro`,
   `corrections.astro`, `watch.astro`, `methodology.astro` drop
   "reproducible"/"permalink"/re-resolution claims; `watch.astro` citation-copy
   reworded.
5. Home: the headline counts keep named denominators and show the headline
   counted quantities only (the 124 per-predicate reconciliation tiles live
   only on `/coverage-metrics/`); capability copy states only what exists;
   dead links to `/visual-language/` and `/research-dossier/` removed.
6. Coverage page: the contradictions metric keeps its honest count and gets an
   explicit note that the recorded contradictions are not yet browsable (that
   view is being built); corrections page gains the log coverage line (release
   as-of + earliest entry) and an honest structural-zero note; methodology
   gains the CC0 statement for the contributed-to-OSM subset.
7. Copy: `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md` gains one row per
   authored sentence on every changed page/component (page, text, sha256,
   `pending`); `data-copy` attributes bind rendered text to rows;
   `tests/unit/test_p34_11_copy_batch.py` enforces the binding +
   `tests/unit/test_p34_11_claim_words.py` scans public source for
   "reproducible"/"permalink" outside disclosed contexts.

  an absence kind ("No record in SIG."). The deeper half — a `coverage_record`
  asserting `sharing_partners`/`not_researched` for a jurisdiction whose record

  re-materialization + re-export path (P34.21b), not rewritable from web code

  facts").
